sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ved Byas Mishra
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding respondents No.
2 & 3 to pay compensation to the petitioner for having taken illegal possession of remaining land of
Gata No. 365, new Gata No. 225 area 0.620 hectare and remaining land of Gata No. 369, new Gata
No. 226 area 0.530 hectare, total area 0.1150 hectare.
2.  It is admitted to the petitioner that the respondents had acquired some part of her holding under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and she was also paid compensation therefor.

3. The case of the petitioner is that the remaining area measuring 0.1150 hectare was illegally included by the Krishi Udpadan Mandi Samiti within its boundary wall without paying any compensation to the petitioner.
She made a representation on 23.07.2024 to the District Magistrate for the payment of compensation for the said area to her but no compensation has been paid to her.

sentences.text: 4. Shri Ved Byas Mishra, learned counsel appearing for respondent No. 3 has placed on record the instructions received from the Secretary, Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti, Prayagraj dated 04.11.2024.
According to it, the Mandi Samiti claims to be in possession of only the area which was acquired and for which compensation was duly paid to the petitioner.

5. Having regard to the stand of respondent No. 3 and nature of dispute between the parties, we are of the opinion that the remedy of the petitioner is to apply for demarcation of her holding under Section 24 of the U.P. Land Revenue Code, 2006.
6. Accordingly, we dispose of the instant petition with aforesaid liberty to the petitioner.

7. In case, any such application is filed by the petitioner along with true copy of the instant order,
the same shall be decided by the concerned Authority expeditiously.
